intro.h2: Careful Tile Work, Even in Older Homes
paragraphs: Neptoon Tile Company does tile installation for kitchens, bathrooms and floors, and the jobs reviewers describe most are backsplashes, showers and new tile in older homes. Jesse is the tile setter customers mention by name.

Two things come up again and again. The first is communication: one customer got daily updates and says that even with extra materials and troubleshooting, the bill matched the original estimate. The second is problem solving: another homeowner wrote that new tile in an old home is never easy, and Jesse handled every challenge with skill. A third customer has hired them for several jobs and mentions great prices.

items.name: Kitchen backsplashes
items.blurb: Backsplash installs are the job Neptoon's reviews talk about most. One customer said the new backsplash looks amazing and pointed to Jesse's skill and attention to detail. Tell Jesse what tile you have in mind when you call to get an estimate.

items.name: Showers and bathroom tile
items.blurb: Their photos include a walk-in shower with white marble subway tile walls, a marble fish-scale mosaic floor with a square drain, a tiled bench and a glass panel. Bathroom remodeling is listed among their services, so ask about full bathroom tile jobs too.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with white marble subway tile walls, marble fish-scale mosaic floor, square drain, tiled bench and brushed gold rain shower head

items.name: Tile floors
items.blurb: Floors are part of the work. One project photo shows large charcoal stone-look tiles laid in an offset pattern through a kitchen and hallway while the rest of the room was still being remodeled. Flooring is listed among Neptoon's services.

image.alt: Large charcoal stone-look floor tiles in an offset pattern through a kitchen under renovation

items.name: Tile in older homes
items.blurb: Old houses rarely have straight walls or level floors. One homeowner wrote that installing new tile in an old home is never easy, and that Jesse's problem solving and attention to detail made a huge difference in the final result.

image.alt: Photo needed: tile work in an older home

items.title: An estimate customers say holds
items.text: One customer wrote that even with extra materials and troubleshooting, Jesse charged the original cost estimate. Ask how changes are handled on your own job.

items.text: The same homeowner appreciated daily communication during the backsplash job, and another reviewer calls their communication excellent. You know where the work stands each day.

items.title: Problem solvers
items.text: One reviewer said Jesse handled every challenge of tiling an old home with professionalism and skill, and that his problem solving made a huge difference in the result.

items.title: Customers come back
items.text: One customer has had multiple things done by Neptoon Tile Company and points to great prices and fantastic work. The owner replies to reviews and thanks customers by name.

about.text: Neptoon Tile Company is a tile contractor whose Google reviews keep pointing to one person: Jesse, whose tiling skill, communication and attention to detail customers mention by name. The business replies to its reviews personally, thanking customers for the chance to install a backsplash or work on their build. Its listed services are bathroom remodeling and flooring, and its photos show marble shower work and large-format floor tile. The shop keeps weekday hours plus Saturday mornings, so it is easy to call about a project.
about.owner_role: Tile setter named in reviews; whether he is the owner is not confirmed

steps.title: Call
steps.text: Call (859) 414-0962 Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 6 PM, or Saturday morning, and describe the tile job you have in mind.

steps.title: Get an estimate
steps.text: You get a cost estimate before work starts. One customer says the final bill matched it even after extra materials were needed.

steps.title: Installation with daily updates
steps.text: Jesse sets the tile and keeps you posted each day, including any problems found once old floors or walls are opened up.

steps.title: Final look
steps.text: Walk the finished tile with Jesse and check the details together before the job is wrapped up.

items.name: Kimberly T.
items.text: We are so glad that we got Neptoon Tile’s to install our new backsplash. It looks amazing! Jesse’s work shows his tiling skills, expertise, and attention to detail. We appreciated his daily communication and that even with extra materials and troubleshooting, he charged the original cost estimate.

items.name: Graham M.
items.text: Jesse really hit it out of the park with all of my tile work. Installing new tile in an old home is never easy, but he handled every challenge with professionalism and skill. His problem-solving ability and attention to detail made a huge difference in the final result. I couldn’t be happier with the quality of his work—highly recommend!

items.name: Ben H.
items.text: I have had multiple things done by Neptoon Tile Company and they have done great work.  Excellent communication, great prices, and fantastic work.  I highly recommend them!

service_area.text: Neptoon Tile Company does not list a street address or a service area on Google, and its Facebook page does not name towns either. The quickest way to find out whether your home is within range is to call (859) 414-0962 and give your town. Jobs are done at your home, whether it is a backsplash, a shower or a whole floor.

items.a: Neptoon Tile Company is open Monday through Friday from 8:30 AM to 6 PM and on Saturday from 8:30 AM to 12:30 PM, according to Google. It is closed on Sunday. Call (859) 414-0962 or email neptoontilecompany@gmail.com to describe your project.

Yes. Backsplashes are the job reviewers mention most. One customer called the new backsplash amazing and said Jesse kept in daily contact and charged the original estimate even when extra materials were needed. Tell them the size of the wall and the tile you like.

items.q: Can you tile in an older house?
items.a: Yes. One homeowner wrote that installing new tile in an old home is never easy, and that Jesse handled every challenge with professionalism, skill and problem solving. Mention the age of the house and any known issues, like uneven floors, when you call.

Google does not show an address or service area for Neptoon Tile Company, and no towns are listed on Facebook. Call (859) 414-0962 with your town and ask whether it is covered before you set up an estimate. Jobs are done at your home, so a short description of the project helps too.

items.q: Are estimates free, and are you insured?
items.a: Free estimates, insurance and warranty terms are not published on Google or Facebook, so ask on the phone. What reviewers do confirm is that a cost estimate was honored and that communication during the job was excellent. Ask about anything else you need in writing before the work starts.

final_cta.text: Call Neptoon Tile Company about your backsplash, shower or floor.
